note: Not on the Chrome Web Store yet (README). This record applies from the first published version: read the published version back, smoke the installed extension, then watch reviews and support for 24 h.

build_readback.how: The published version in the developer dashboard equals extension/manifest.json version, and the uploaded zip SHA-256 equals the deterministic build (scripts/build.mjs, scripts/verify-zip.py).

store.backend_reason: The extension has no server: licences are verified offline with license-pubkey.js and nothing is sent to a BlueSkyz API.
